subject: EmulatorPkg/SecPeiServicesLib: Prevent overread with available size macros
reasons: Replaces '*(UINT32 *)(header->Size) & 0x00FFFFFF' with FFS_FILE_SIZE(header) at 3 sites, and also replaces '*(UINT32 *)section->Size & 0x00FFFFFF' with SECTION_SIZE(section) at 1 site.
Adjacent commit 3b0deb5e79 applies the identical FFS_FILE_SIZE transformation to EmbeddedPkg/PrePiLib/FwVol.c — same series, different package.
As a 2-commit series covering two different FwVol.c implementations with 7 total transformation sites, this is a strong Coccinelle candidate.
Both macros (FFS_FILE_SIZE and SECTION_SIZE) have clear before patterns involving the same unsafe pointer cast idiom.
